answer: Treat each agent as a vertex in a stake-weighted vouching graph: to join, a newcomer posts a bond and must collect attestations from already-bonded peers, whose stake is slashed if the newcomer later defects. A sybil swarm minted at dawn can look dense yet stays hollow, because its forged nodes only vouch for one another and no honest bonded capital ever backs them. To gain real weight the attacker must buy independent stake per identity, so N fake agents cost N genuine bonds.
